groups.meta: unlocks the Operator and Void Mode
conditions: Only an Operator Void Mode attack kills the Vomvalyst energy form; Warframe weapons alone flip the shell to energy form and drop nothing.

groups.activity: hunt Vomvalysts at night, finish with Operator Void Mode

rows.label: Intact Sentient Core
rows.note: kill the physical shell, then finish the energy form with Operator Void damage
rows.alt: ride along on a Teralyst hunt for ~20 at once

conditions: Kill Vomvalysts away from any Eidolon Lure; a Lure absorbs the energy form before it drops a core.
The energy form reforms at full health after 20 seconds, so don't break the shell until you're ready to switch to Operator.
bonuses: Archon Hunts (interception or defense stages) and Lua Sentient missions also drop cores if the Plains aren't convenient.

disclosures.title: why public groups whiff this
disclosures.body: Shooting the physical shell with a Warframe weapon only flips it to its energy form; it drops nothing until an Operator Void attack kills that form.

conditions: Argon halves at 00:00 UTC once picked up, so farm it right before the build, not days ahead.

rows.label: Phantasma
rows.note: 20,000 cr, 2 Argon Crystal, 10 Intact Sentient Core, 650 Plastids, 12,500 Nano Spores

conditions: 12,500 Nano Spores can be a bigger blocker than the cores for a returning player with a low stash.
